claims: The 130th Boston Marathon takes place on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The Boston Marathon is held annually on Patriots' Day.
Patriots' Day is the third Monday of April.
The Boston Marathon follows a 26.2-mile course from Hopkinton to Boston's Copley Square.
The Boston Marathon Expo runs from Friday, April 17, through Sunday, April 19, 2026.
The location of the 2026 Boston Marathon is Hopkinton to Boston, MA.
